**Finding submitted: deviation (NOSOLICIT), fallback target.**

- **Responsive clause:** § 13 (p0047) is the only non-solicit in the agreement; nothing comparable appears in the engagement (§ 1), termination (§ 6), or elsewhere (searches for "induce", "no-hire", "general advertisement", "personnel" returned no other covenant).
- **Already at fallback:** mutual ("Neither party shall"), scope limited to "personnel who have had direct involvement with the Services", and solicitation-only (no no-hire).
- **Fails fallback:** duration runs for the term *plus* one year after termination (can far exceed 12 months from the end of an individual's involvement, potentially beyond the 24-month walk-away line), and there are no carve-outs for general advertisements or unsolicited approaches.
- **Redline (validated, minimality ok):** re-anchor the period to twelve months from the end of the relevant individual's involvement, and add one short carve-out sentence — the consent mechanic and all other wording preserved.
